items.title: Nick Mondello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 19, 2022
items.q: Yes. Heyman, Green, there are four names here.

ctx.x: Wow. Normally I try to take some aspect of the recording and bring like a metaphor into it, okay? And then use that as a launch point for the review of the music itself. Okay? So let’s say for example “Body and Soul.” “Body and Soul” I believe was written by Johnny Green?
Yes. Heyman, Green, there are four names here.
